sourceTitle: Let Gemini tackle repetitive chores on your Mac
originalTitle: Let Gemini tackle repetitive chores on your Mac
author: Michael Friedman

blocks.text: Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web. This saves you time on the repetitive work that normally takes dozens of clicks. Just describe what you need, and Gemini handles the clicking, typing, menus, and forms for you.
blocks.zh: 从今天起，Mac 版 Gemini 应用中的计算机使用功能可帮助你在本地文件、桌面应用和网页中完成多步骤任务。这能为你节省通常需要数十次点击的重复性工作的时间。只需描述你的需求，Gemini 就会为你处理点击、输入、菜单和表单。
blocks.en: Starting today, computer use in the Gemini app for Mac helps you get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web. This saves you time on the repetitive work that normally takes dozens of clicks. Just describe what you need, and Gemini handles the clicking, typing, menus, and forms for you.

blocks.text: Gemini works inside an isolated background window with a live preview right in your chat. Your main screen and cursor remain completely free, so you can keep typing, designing, or taking calls without interruption. Privacy and safety are built in: you choose which apps Gemini can access, watch every step live, pause at any time, and approve key actions before they happen.
blocks.zh: Gemini 在一个隔离的后台窗口中运行，并在你的聊天中提供实时预览。你的主屏幕和光标完全不受影响，因此你可以继续打字、设计或接听电话而不会中断。隐私和安全性已内置：你可以选择 Gemini 可以访问哪些应用，实时观看每一步，随时暂停，并在关键操作发生前批准它们。
blocks.en: Gemini works inside an isolated background window with a live preview right in your chat. Your main screen and cursor remain completely free, so you can keep typing, designing, or taking calls without interruption. Privacy and safety are built in: you choose which apps Gemini can access, watch every step live, pause at any time, and approve key actions before they happen.

blocks.text: Here are a few ways you can start trying it today:
blocks.zh: 以下是今天就可以开始尝试的几种方式：
blocks.en: Here are a few ways you can start trying it today:

blocks.text: Speed up creative workflows: Batch color-grade photos in your favorite design software or set up complex 3D scenes.
blocks.zh: 加快创意工作流程：在你喜欢的设计软件中批量对照片进行调色，或搭建复杂的三维场景。
blocks.en: Speed up creative workflows: Batch color-grade photos in your favorite design software or set up complex 3D scenes.

blocks.text: Skip manual form entry: Extract weights, dimensions, and addresses from local PDFs to fill out multi-box shipping quotes.
blocks.zh: 跳过手动填写表单：从本地 PDF 中提取重量、尺寸和地址，填写多箱货运报价单。
blocks.en: Skip manual form entry: Extract weights, dimensions, and addresses from local PDFs to fill out multi-box shipping quotes.

blocks.text: Turn live data into ready-to-present decks: Pull metrics and screenshots from live dashboards across multiple regions and build a presentation in Google Slides.
blocks.zh: 将实时数据转化为可直接演示的幻灯片：从多个地区的实时仪表板中提取指标和截图，并在 Google Slides 中制作演示文稿。
blocks.en: Turn live data into ready-to-present decks: Pull metrics and screenshots from live dashboards across multiple regions and build a presentation in Google Slides.

blocks.text: Batch-list items for sale: Analyze clothing photos from a local folder, research pricing, log item details, and stage listings on resale platforms.
blocks.zh: 批量上架待售物品：分析本地文件夹中的服装照片，研究定价，记录物品详情，并在转售平台上准备上架信息。
blocks.en: Batch-list items for sale: Analyze clothing photos from a local folder, research pricing, log item details, and stage listings on resale platforms.

blocks.text: Computer use is rolling out in English in the U.S. in the Gemini app for Mac. 1 Download the app at gemini.google/mac to get started.
blocks.zh: 计算机使用功能正在美国以英语在 Mac 版 Gemini 应用中逐步推出。1 访问 gemini.google/mac 下载应用即可开始使用。
blocks.en: Computer use is rolling out in English in the U.S. in the Gemini app for Mac. 1 Download the app at gemini.google/mac to get started.
